preferences.title: Purchase preferences of {{name}}
preferences.help: The purchase list uses these preferences to find the copies of the collection that fit the line.
preferences.languagesHint: Select no language to accept each language.
preferences.printingsHint: With no wanted printing, each printing that is not avoided fits the line.
preferences.printingsError: The printings did not load. You can set the other preferences.
preferences.otherPrinting: Printing that is not in the list
preferences.priceHint: Leave the amount empty for no limit. The plain text export shows the maximum price.
preferences.invalidPrice: The amount is not valid. Give an amount more than 0, for example 2.50.

page.title: Purchase list of {{name}}
page.loading: The application calculates the purchase list.
page.help: The purchase list compares the deck with the available cards of the collection. The cards that stay are the cards to buy.
page.caption: Lines of the purchase list
page.nothingToBuy: The collection has all the cards of the deck. There is no card to buy.
page.empty: The deck has no card in these zones.
page.lockedHint: Unlock {{place}} before you move the cards.
page.lockedAlert: Some cards are in a locked location. Unlock the location before you move the cards.
page.noClosest: The collection has no other copy of this card.

reasons.finishNonfoil: Foil, and the line wants nonfoil
reasons.unavailable: In another assembled deck or in a location that is not pickable

export.title: Export the cards to buy

hints.cardmarket: One line for each card: the quantity and the English card name. Paste the text in a wants list of Cardmarket.
hints.tcgplayer: One line for each card: the quantity, the English card name and the set code when the line wants one printing. Paste the text in the mass entry of TCGplayer.
hints.text: One line for each card, with the printing and the maximum price when the line has them.

export.copied: The text is in the clipboard.
export.copyFailed: The browser did not copy the text. Download the file.

proxies.print: Print proxies of the cards to buy
proxies.working: The application makes the PDF file.
proxies.failed_one: {{count}} image did not load. The PDF file shows the card name in its frame.
proxies.failed_other: {{count}} images did not load. The PDF file shows the card names in their frames.
proxies.error: The application could not make the PDF file. Try again.
